'''2007 Kashyyyk Regionals Richard Halstead DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Richard Halstead]] at [[2007 Kashyyyk Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Set Your Course for $ System
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
